name: grok-bot-local
description: Local free Grok Bot clone MVP — Ollama + tools + memory + routines

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @grok-bot/server" "npm run dev -w @grok-bot/web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "cross-env HOST=0.0.0.0 npm run dev -w @grok-bot/server" "npm run dev:lan -w @grok-bot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && npm run build -w @grok-bot/server && npm run build -w @grok-bot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @grok-bot/server && npm run typecheck -w @grok-bot/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop install && concurrently -k -s first "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8787/health && npm run start:desktop" "npm start"
scripts.mobile: npm run build && npm run start:lan
